transcript.text: I still think about that Chengdu trip in 2025—everyone kept tossing around attraction ideas like it was a whole spreadsheet.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that spring I did that Beijing to Shanghai run—so many people were comparing train options like it was a sport.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then in Wuhan, the group chat was basically just hotel talk the entire time, which was kind of hilarious in hindsight.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Chengdu, I remember the Giant Panda Base was the big one everybody mentioned, and I went on 2025-05-27.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I did the afternoon slot, and it was under my name, Cao Yun—just 1 ticket since I split off from the others that day.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That Beijing–Shanghai train day was 2025-03-15, and my ticket was on D321—Cao Yun again, because it was all tied to my ID.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and for Wuhan we stayed at Shangri-La Wuhan—check-in was 2025-04-05 for 2 nights, but it was booked under Liu Yang, not me. Also, I was in Second Class on that train, which honestly was totally fine.
